# Projects

The portfolio is organized by application area. Each project page focuses on the problem,
my role, system architecture, engineering decisions, validation and the evidence produced.

## Organ Perfusion & Transplantation

::: {.project-list}
### [Master's Thesis — Ex Vivo Liver Viability with ICG-NIR](thesis.qmd)
A three-objective research project: build a stable ex vivo liver perfusion platform, characterize a physiological baseline without ICG, and develop an ICG-NIR functional marker.

### [Borealis UC — Organ Supercooling](borealis.qmd)
Research project on organ preservation through supercooling.

### [Organ Preservation Machine Redesign](organ-preservation.qmd)
Electromechanical redesign and miniaturization of an organ preservation machine.
:::

## Medical Devices & Neuroengineering

::: {.project-list}
### [CandelStim — Transcranial Electrical Stimulation](candel.qmd)
Hardware, firmware and system integration for transcranial electrical stimulation.

### Advanced Neurostimulation Studies
Follow-on technical study of temporal interference stimulation, current sources, DDS/NCO, DACs, synchronization, impedance measurement and validation approaches.
:::

## Robotics & Rehabilitation

::: {.project-list}
### [Ciervo UC — CYBATHLON 2024](cybathlon.qmd)
Electrical Area Leader for a robotic transfemoral prosthesis developed for CYBATHLON 2024.
:::

## Medical Imaging & AI

::: {.project-list}
### [Lung Segmentation with U-Net](unet.qmd)
Medical image segmentation project using U-Net for lung images.
:::

## Embedded Systems & FPGA

::: {.project-list}
### [FPGA Upgrade for Universal Testing Machine](fpga.qmd)
Signal-processing and embedded hardware using Zybo Z10, Vivado and VHDL.
:::

## CAD & Prototyping

::: {.project-list}
### [Vscan Air Medical Device Enclosure](vscan.qmd)
3D design and prototyping for a medical ultrasound device accessory.
:::
